name: hcoll_v5_ctl2-v7h-COMMIT
purpose: COLL V7 ctl2 native-capture rekit: same RTL/outline/pins, input hold pad HB1 + hold margin 15 ps (closed e11086804 native C197.3 on dest_v[1] from hold padding)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_coll_ctl_v5_q2 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hfd_coll_q_hard_v5.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hgi_coll_ctl_v5.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.015 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_ctl2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_ctl2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_ctl2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_coll_ctl_v5_q2  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

reroute_reason.fix: input hold pad HB2 -> HB1 and route hold margin 30 -> 15 ps: the failing dest_v[1] capture path is pure hold padding (HB2 + BUFx4f + 6 BUFx2) at R 209.8; same RTL, outline and pin faces
